recommendations.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 大规模推理部署实践
recommendations.verdict: 少见的把线上推理系统逐层摊开讲的长文，工程细节密度很高
recommendations.reason: 不是概念科普：PD 分离怎么配卡、KVCache 分几层放哪、负载均衡用什么代价模型、投机解码怎么变长验证，每一步都给线上数字和取舍理由，可以直接对照自己手上的推理服务。
key_points: 单集群日吞吐 155 万亿 tokens，按谷价折算每卡每小时 38 美元收入；推理框架 DeepInfer 与 tokenizer 组件 deepseek-recipe 已开源。
Prefill 用 8 卡机、Decode 用 64～128 卡超节点，KVCache 目标保留 72 小时以上；Block KVCache 落在 3FS 独立存储集群，agent 流量 TTL 3 天、chatbot 7 天。
SWA KVCache 不落盘，只留内存、TTL 约 180 秒、命中率 98% 以上；缺失时用 SWA Bounded Replay 只重算最近 128 个 token，decoder 侧 prefill 计算量近乎减半。

recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是今年最值得存档的推理系统工程文之一，它把「大模型服务怎么在真实集群上跑得便宜」拆成了可复用的设计决策，而不是只报一个 benchmark 分数。

1. 目标先立住，再谈技术。文章开头给三个硬约束：兼容多家芯片（英伟达与昇腾）、用常见硬件组织 Prefill 和 Decode（8 卡做 Prefill，64～128 卡超节点做 Decode）、KVCache 保留 72 小时以上。这三条基本决定了后面所有架构选择：PD 分离不是为了时髦，而是因为两个阶段的负载特征（算力密集 vs 访存密集）差得太远，混在一起配卡必然有一半资源在等。

2. KVCache 是全文的主线，也是最可借鉴的部分。Block KVCache 以 128 token 为块分页管理，放在独立的 3FS 集群而不是本机内存，理由讲得很清楚：独立存储让任何 Prefill 机器都能命中任何前缀，避免「前缀亲和路由」和「负载均衡路由」互相打架；同时存储与计算解耦，计算节点故障不再带走缓存。3FS 给到约 100 PiB SSD、峰值读 10 TiB/s、写 850 GiB/s，按 112 KiB 的块粒度做随机读写优化，纠删码 10+2。agent 流量 TTL 3 天、chatbot 7 天，作者还给了经验值：TTL 砍到 3 天左右，chatbot 命中率会掉 0.5%～1%。

3. SWA KVCache 的处理是全文最有信息量的取舍。V4 时代把 SWA 也落盘做精确重算，结果分钟级生命期的数据占掉近一半持久缓存容量，不划算；V4.1 改成不落盘、只留内存（TTL 约 180 秒、命中率 98%+），缺失时用 Bounded Replay 只重算最近 128 个 token 并把注意力窗口截断在重算段内，重算代价变成与上下文长度、层数无关的常数。这一改让 Decoder 侧每次 prefill 的计算量近乎减半——这是「想清楚数据的生命期」比「堆更多 SSD」更值钱的典型例子。

4. 负载均衡与调度给了可抄的量化模型。Prefill 按输入长度分四档，用拟合的二次代价模型 cost(q, c) 反解每步能塞多少 token；Decode 同时均衡请求数和 KVCache 总长两个维度；专家并行靠冗余专家 + 周期性重排，线上最慢 rank 与均值之比做到 1.032（EP2/DP2）和 1.090（EP64）。调度层把 schedule(N+1) 与 forward(N) 在 CPU/GPU 上重叠，GPU 全程无空闲。这些数字和做法，对自建 vLLM/SGLang 集群的人几乎是现成 checklist。

5. 值得留意的边界。KVCache 管理与负载均衡组件因与内部基础设施耦合深，这次没有完整开源；DeepInfer 开的是框架与算子，deepseek-recipe 开的是 API 协议到 token 序列的编解码（Rust 实现，含 special token 注入防护与分段并行编码）。也就是说，文章里的系统能力不能直接 clone 出来，但设计意图和取舍逻辑完全可迁移。

recommendations.title: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents
recommendations.verdict: 把 agent 记忆做成工程系统的完整案例，含真实企业基准与消融
recommendations.reason: 少见地同时给出质量、token 和时延三组数字，并用消融说明「哪种记忆真正起作用」；对正在给 agent 加长期记忆的团队，可以直接照抄它的分层与读写时机。
key_points: 内部企业基准上通过率从 22.3% 提到 68.4%（约三倍），同时 token 少 31%、端到端快 26%，追平「只注入金标记忆」上限的 80% 以上。
开源基准上 88.1% 的准确率与全上下文 87.8% 持平，但每题输入 token 从 10.3 万降到 8.4 千（约 1/12）。
两层记忆：episodic 存原始会话轨迹（append-only），derived 存蒸馏后的知识文件，顶层用自动生成的 memory.md 索引告诉 agent「自己知道什么」。
消融结论清楚：只用 derived 记忆 66.1%，只用 episodic 35.8%，两者相加 68.4%；离线 dreaming 抽取（63.5%）明显优于纯在线工具（53.9%），两者结合最好。
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这篇的价值不在「记忆很重要」，而在于它把记忆拆成可测量的工程组件，用消融告诉你每一层各值多少分，并给出了生产环境里真正跑得动的读写时机。

1. 问题定义得准。作者先指出记忆的核心矛盾不是「存得多」，而是「存什么、怎么维护、怎么衡量有用」：把所有历史塞进上下文又贵又容易引入过期、冲突、无关的信息。这一点比很多记忆框架讲得清楚——记忆系统的对手不是「没有记忆」，而是「全上下文」这个昂贵上限。

2. 架构是两层加三种访问方式。episodic memory 以插件形式在会话过程中自动追加，记录原始轨迹；derived memory 是可变的知识文件，由 agent 工具（add/update/delete）响应显式指令，加上一个离线「dreaming」流水线从新会话里蒸馏隐含经验，并负责拆分超大文件、合并重复、解决冲突。读取侧在会话开始时注入 memory.md 索引，会话中提供 search_memory 与 fetch_memory 两个工具，分别做模糊检索和按 id 取全文。这套「索引常驻、正文按需」的分层，和人类查文档的习惯一致，也解释了为什么它比纯向量检索省 token。

3. 评测做得比多数厂商博客扎实。开源基准（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、ConvoMem）之外，他们从 12000+ 条真实 Genie 会话里挖出 3000 条候选，再经对抗式评审按 7 项标准筛到 114 个测试用例、29 个用户、2233 条历史会话。关键在于「记忆要喂给动作，而不只是回答问题」：用例要求 agent 在 100 多条历史里找到那次纠正并应用到新的多步任务上。这比合成对话里的「回忆某个事实」难得多，也更能暴露真实差距。

4. 数字和消融是最有说服力的部分。内部基准上 MemCurrent 通过率 68.4%（无记忆 22.3%、金标注入 78.6%），时延 252 秒、token 41.8 万，均为最低；Mem0 在同基准上只有 43.9% 且更慢更贵——同一个 Mem0 在开源基准上却在前沿，说明基准选错会得出完全相反的结论。消融进一步指出：derived 记忆贡献主要增益（66.1%），episodic 只加 2.3 个点，但能找回蒸馏丢掉的细节；抽取策略上离线 dreaming（63.5%）比纯在线工具（53.9%）高近 10 个点，两者合用最优。

5. 两个真实例子比数字更直观。一个是 agent 写了正确 SQL 却没读执行结果、凭空编了表格，用户纠正一次后把教训写进记忆，下次先读结果；另一个是「SDP 客户 top5」这类问题从 11 次工具调用、8 个子代理、近 6 分钟，压缩到 2 次调用、1 个子代理、41 秒——因为工作流被存成了可复用的记忆文件。后者其实是把「探索成本」变成「资产」，这也是 agent 记忆最容易被低估的收益。

我的推荐：如果你在做企业内部 agent，先读第 2 节（架构）和第 4 节（消融），再回头看它的基准构建方法——那套「从真实会话挖用例 + 对抗评审」的流程，比任何记忆库选型都更值得抄。

recommendations.title: Introducing TorchTPU
recommendations.verdict: 原生 PyTorch 上 TPU 的完整技术交代，含架构、精度与六个案例
recommendations.reason: 把「换一个加速器」从口号落到工程细节：eager 怎么实现、编译缓存怎么分层、精度模式代价多少、分布式怎么映射到 ICI/DCN，还给了 HuggingFace 覆盖率和第三方推理成本数据。
key_points: 近 5000 个 HuggingFace 模型端到端跑通（Tier 1 通过率 98%，4821/4917），657 个架构代表模型的数值对齐率 97%。
单卡纯 PyTorch 推理（Muse Glimmer 30B，5120 序列）约 25.7k TPS、59% MFU；DeferAndFuse eager 模式比逐算子 eager 快 50% 以上并降低 HBM 峰值。
Qwen3 MoE 235B 在 8192 张 TPU v7 上训练 MFU 稳定在 27% 左右，1 到 8 个 slice 弱扩展接近线性。
第三方 SemiAnalysis 数据显示 vLLM-TorchTPU 在 8K/1K 场景每百万 token 成本 2.01 美分，agent 场景 0.83 美分。
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：如果 2025 年的 PyTorch/XLA 还像「把 PyTorch 硬塞进 JAX 的做事方式」，这篇就是在宣布另一条路线——把 TPU 当成 PyTorch 的一等后端来做，并且给出了足以判断成熟度的证据。

1. 设计原则先摆明，和旧方案划清界限。运行时不含 JAX 依赖、eager 模式必须好用、torch.compile 走 Dynamo 而不是 Lazy Tensor、在 PyTorch 最底层（Process Group API）提供 TPU 集合通信、把 `.to("cuda")` 换成 `.to("tpu")` 就能跑。作者也直说旧 PyTorch/XLA 的三个硬伤：要改源码划编译区、编译时延严重、没有原生 eager。这些不是营销话术，后面每一节都在兑现。

2. 实现路径值得细读。TorchTPU 通过 PrivateUse1 扩展 dispatcher，用 c10::StorageImpl 定义设备侧存储；eager 有三种模态——Strict（逐算子异步，等价 GPU eager）、Debug（同步 + 边界检查）、DeferAndFuse（把连续算子延迟并融合，官方称比 Strict 快 50%+，还降低 HBM 峰值）。DeferAndFuse 的关键是「物化点」：遇到 `.to("cpu")`、`.item()` 才把累积的计算图编译执行，中间用存活分析挑出必须物化的算子，副作用算子（集合通信）永远保留；再加一个 Repeated Ops 启发式，在重复的 transformer 块上提前触发物化。编译缓存分三层（进程内、同机共享内存、远端文件系统），缓存键把计算图结构、张量尺寸、编译选项与组件版本压成三个 64 位整数，避免把巨大的 StableHLO 当键。

3. 精度的处理是很多人会踩的坑。TPU 的 MXU 原生做 BF16 乘加、FP32 累加，所以 TorchTPU 默认 medium 精度；high 用 3 趟分解、highest 用 6 趟，分别约 3 倍和 6 倍算力开销，选高精度会直接触发性能告警。这和 CUDA 上「默认 FP32、TF32 是加速选项」正好相反——从 GPU 迁过来的模型如果默认精度敏感，很可能在不知情的情况下变慢或变准。

4. 案例部分含金量最高。HuggingFace 语料 4917 个模型、500+ 架构族，Tier 1 冒烟通过 98%、Tier 2 数值对齐 97%，bounded dynamism 在 839 个因果 LLM 上 834 个数值正确；纯 PyTorch 写的 Muse Glimmer 30B 在单张 TPUv7 上 prefill 25.7k TPS / 59% MFU；Qwen3 MoE 235B 在 8192 卡上 MFU 27% 左右、弱扩展几乎线性，靠的是把 all-reduce 与相邻层计算重叠；vLLM 侧的三个优化（MoE 层作为单个 SPMD 程序、sequence-on-lane 的 FP8 KV 布局把 KV 显存减半、Gated DeltaNet 的融合 kernel）都给了具体瓶颈数字，例如原来 reduce-scatter 每层 1190 微秒、占设备时间 22%。

5. 该保留的怀疑。文章自己承认 RL colocation 因「一个 TPU 只能被一个用户态进程访问」暂不支持，FlexAttention 还没覆盖，FP8/FP4 与嵌套编译区仍在路线图上；多数漂亮数字来自 Google 自家调优过的栈（Pallas kernel、TorchTitan、vLLM-TorchTPU），纯 PyTorch 开箱的 MFU 在 30%～38% 区间，离峰值仍有距离。换句话说：迁移门槛确实降到了「改一行 device」，但要拿到成本优势，还是得做设备特定的调优。

我的推荐：想判断「要不要认真评估 TPU」的人，读第 1、2 节和案例 1、4 就够做决策；准备真迁移的，重点看精度模式表和 DeferAndFuse 的物化点逻辑——这两处最容易在上线后变成事故或性能悬崖。

items.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs (4 minute read)
items.summary: The eight intermediate certificates, which belong to India-based certificate authority eMudhra Limited, were defective at a level thought not possible by engineers studying the incident.
items.score_reason: 八张中间证书存在缺陷，波及范围与信任链影响分析。
items.highlight: eMudhra 八张中间证书的私钥被证明可被外部掌握，足以给任意站点签发受信任证书；浏览器与主流语言已封禁，但 Linux 发行版、容器与 IoT 的清理比 Heartbleed 更大。
items.excerpt: Security personnel around the world are on high alert Tuesday following the discovery of eight TLS certificates with private keys so weak they could allow anyone to mint trusted browser and app credentials for any site on the Internet.

items.title: How to Build a Decision Model Like Jev (17 minute read)
items.summary: Decision models return probabilities over known outcomes in a single forward pass, avoiding the text generation and JSON parsing overhead of chat completions. This walkthrough starts with Hugging Face's /v1/systemone endpoint, then covers reserved option tokens, calibration, soft training targets, and tree batching for multiple questions over shared context.
items.score_reason: 从零构建决策模型的具体实现路径。
items.highlight: 决策模型不做自回归解码：状态与问题拼成一条序列，选项描述后放 <opt_k>、末尾放 <readout>，一次前向得到各选项 softmax。温度按题型分别拟合，不确定标签用软目标训练；树批处理用块对角掩码把 N 个问题打包进一次前向。
items.excerpt: In my LLM inference roadmap, I split every model call into two phases. Prefill reads the prompt in parallel and is compute-bound. Decode emits output tokens one at a time, reading the entire weight matrix from HBM on every step, and is memory-bandwidth bound.

items.title: How Kiro Fixes Itself, and How We Keep the Fixes Honest (12 minute read)
items.summary: Kiro mines its own execution traces to find wasted effort and propose prompt or tool changes, while deterministic gates test improvements against fresh controls and a permanent regression suite. Seven fixes merged in the first week, and a compaction change raised internal retention scores from 0.82 to 0.92. The reported gains come from internal experiments, and every accepted change still requires human code review.
items.score_reason: Kiro 用自身执行轨迹自动改进提示与工具，并以确定性闸门验证。
items.highlight: kiro-trace 把提议者与裁判分开：模型只提改动，接受与否由代码判断，按 delta 比较并每次重跑对照组。首周 8 个 PR 合并 7 个，删减工具后 Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 77.5% 升到 82.4%。
items.excerpt: One sentence in Kiro’s file-read and search tool descriptions made a false claim about how the harness behaves, and it reached the model 61,742 times across a few hundred sessions. It did nothing useful, and it’s unlikely anyone would have filed a ticket for it.

items.title: Lambda Web Functions: Public by Default, and Already in Your lambda:* Grants (5 minute read)
items.summary: Lambda Web Functions are a new AWS feature that allow for running a Node.js HTTP server behind a managed HTTPS domain. By default, the functions run with no authentication, and role credentials are included as environment variables, which could potentially be leaked for the full duration of the execution environment. Existing roles that grant lambda:* permissions have access to web functions by default, existing SCPs may not cover them, and visibility tooling may also miss functions, leading to the potential for shadow Web Functions being created and going unnoticed.
items.score_reason: Lambda Web Functions 默认公开且落在既有权限范围内的问题。
items.highlight: Web Function 默认不认证，单环境并发处理最多 64 个请求并共享内存与 /tmp，单请求漏洞可跨租户；新动作落在 lambda 命名空间，通配授权自动放行，主流态势扫描器尚无对应资源类型。
items.excerpt: AWS launched Lambda Web Functions on 13 October. Four access facts matter more than the rest: the endpoint auth type defaults to none, the execution role is shared by every request in an environment, existing `lambda:*` policies already cover the new actions, and the posture scanners cannot see the resource yet.

items.title: Package Manager Sandboxing (7 minute read)
items.summary: Homebrew developer Andrew Nesbitt explains Homebrew 7.0's split fetch and install phases as well as the Landlock and Seatbelt-based sandboxes. Nesbitt then reviews the sandbox implementations, allowlist implementations, and sandbox proposals from other package managers. Some package managers like Go and Elm go a step further by fully removing code execution.
items.score_reason: Homebrew 7.0 抓取与安装分离及系统沙箱的设计。
items.highlight: Homebrew 7 把安装拆成联网下载与离线只读两段，Linux 侧改用内核内建 Landlock；npm、pip、Cargo 提案仍悬置，pnpm 与 Deno 照搬 agent 的 Seatbelt/Landlock 组合。
items.excerpt: Homebrew 7.0.0 shipped on September 13th with “stronger sandboxing” in the opening line of the release notes. Installation is being split into a fetch phase that has network access and writable caches, and an install phase that runs offline with read-only caches.

items.title: Inside Cairn: Open Windows into massive AI-Driven Cyber Operations (16 minute read)
items.summary: NorForge found more than 20 publicly exposed Cairn panels used for malicious intrusion work. One Chinese-language cluster ran over 1,100 attack projects against e-commerce and payment systems in the US, Japan, Australia, and Canada, seeking unauthenticated RCE, file-upload webshells, SQL injection, and authentication bypasses. Another cluster targeted merchant payment, crypto, and pharmaceutical sites for card and cryptocurrency theft. The panels exposed targets, credentials, API keys, agent instructions, and successful compromises. Trufflehog found hundreds of secrets, with 11% verified valid. NorForge is notifying victims and seeking panel takedowns.
items.score_reason: 公开暴露的 Cairn 面板与规模化 AI 攻击作业的取证分析。
items.highlight: 用 Shodan 和 Censys 可发现多个未设防的 Cairn 控制台，AIA0001 一簇就有 14 个面板、1100 个项目，先经 Playwright 验证再交 agent 找未授权 RCE；面板中扫出数百密钥，11% 有效。
items.excerpt: An investigation by NorForge into publicly exposed AI-driven penetration-testing control panels has uncovered how they are extensively used in malicious cyber operations. One of these is Cairn.

items.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models (16 minute read)
items.summary: Cloudflare has announced a preview of Clairic, a new System One extraction model hosted on Workers AI designed to extract, compute, estimate, and forecast values from unstructured inputs. Unlike traditional large language models, Clairic operates in a single forward pass without generating tokens, offering faster latency and lower costs while returning strongly typed outputs with confidence scores. The company intends to release the model with open weights soon.
items.score_reason: Cloudflare 新一类抽取模型在 Workers AI 上的预览。
items.highlight: Cloudflare 预览 Clairic：不生成 token 的单次前向抽取模型，按字段类型返回原文 span、带 p_null 和置信度的数值，还能给区间估计与预测，30 个字段几乎与 3 个同价，权重将开源。
items.excerpt: Today, we're announcing a preview of a new class of System One-style models: extraction models. Our first one, Clairic, is available hosted on Workers AI as `@cf/cloudflare/clairic.`We intend to release the model open-weights soon.

items.title: Nvidia Vera's System Architecture: Pushing Bandwidth (8 minute read)
items.summary: Nvidia's Vera server chip features a high per-core performance architecture backed by a massive 1024-bit LPDDR5X memory interface and second-generation Scalable Coherency Fabric. The chip delivers high memory bandwidth and low latency under load, though its cross-socket and core-to-core latencies lag behind competitors like AMD and Amazon. SPEC CPU2026 benchmarks show Vera achieves strong single-socket throughput in memory-bandwidth-bound workloads while trading core count for per-core performance.
items.score_reason: Nvidia Vera 的 1024 位内存接口与系统架构分析。
items.highlight: Vera 实测：1024 位 LPDDR5X 提供 1.228TB/s 带宽、164MB 共享 L3，满载访存仍不超 200ns；跨 socket NVLink C2C 带宽达 780GB/s，延迟却落后 AMD。
items.excerpt: Nvidia’s Vera server chip aims for high per-core performance. Its Olympus cores have massive out-of-order structures and use high per-clock throughput to meet that goal within a high core count server chip.

items.title: Can a Million AI Agents Create Superintelligence (40 minute read)
items.summary: Today's feedback loop is probably too weak, as improving AI faces diminishing returns at every step.
items.score_reason: 探讨大量 agent 反馈闭环能否通向更强能力。
items.highlight: 文章把规模收益分为超线性、线性、幂律、对数与次对数五档，指出实测多智能体在难题上的智能增益远低于 RSI 模型假设，并用 Anthropic 研究代理的工时比给出可证伪的预测与三个跟踪指标。
items.excerpt: In my [previous post on RSI](https://www.rameznaam.com/p/ai-rsi-isnt-leading-to-super-intelligence), we asked whether AIs could improve themselves all the way to absurdly high levels of superintelligence. My conclusion: today's feedback loop is probably too weak, because improving AI faces diminishing returns at every step.

items.title: Publish stats, get cited: The tactic that put my data all over the web (15 minute read)
items.summary: Research means fanout queries asking for statistics, and a number looks like evidence that can fill knowledge gaps.
items.score_reason: 公开统计数据换取被引用的内容分发策略。
items.highlight: 实验站点花了约 50 美元生成 5 万条虚构统计，七个月内拿到 330 多个引用域名和 1 万多次 ChatGPT 会话；作者据此指出检索与排名是两套机制，模型只做相关性重排、不做事实核验。
items.excerpt: About 7 months ago, I launched a website with 50,000 statistics. Every one of them was fake. Google has forgotten the site exists and deindexed the pages, but ChatGPT hasn't.

items.title: How To Use Decision Models for Evals (23 minute read)
items.summary: Decision models are an appealing alternative to LLM judges for automated evals. However, whether they're the right choice depends on the cost, performance, and latency requirements of the use case. Many people leave the default decision threshold at 0.50 without checking whether that's appropriate for the task, leaving a lot of performance on the table. This post shows how to tune thresholds to get the best results from decision models, compares cost and performance between models, and explores how to interpret model scores and how calibration can make them more useful.
items.score_reason: 决策模型与 LLM judge 做自动评测的成本与准确率对比方法论。
items.highlight: 作者用公寓租赁客服 trace 对比四款决策模型：OpenAI F1 0.87 最高，但成本约为 Perplexity 的 4.5 倍；多数人仍用 0.5 默认阈值，白白损失召回。
items.excerpt: Decision models have exploded onto the scene recently, starting with TypeSafe’s Jev, followed by Perplexity’s Decider, Liquid’s d1, Cloudflare’s Clef, and OpenAI’s Decisions API. These models promise fast, inexpensive classification.

items.title: Building Laminar: Ramp's Managed Agents Platform (14 minute read)
items.summary: Laminar is an in-house agent harness for Ramp's agentic products. It features secure conversation history storage, session compaction, standard interfaces for tool calling, message queuing and steering, subagents, multiplayer chat support, observability tooling, and much more. The first version of Laminar was built in six weeks with a small team of obsessive, experienced engineers who worked with and steered the agents. Its code was generated entirely by agents using the most powerful models available at the time. While building in-house has become cheaper, Ramp still needs good engineers to be on-call, keep the platform healthy, and figure out what product teams actually need and how it fits into the bigger picture.
items.score_reason: Ramp 自研 agent harness 的会话存储、压缩与接口设计。
items.highlight: Ramp 放弃各家托管 agent API 自建 Laminar：会话状态与沙箱生命周期解耦存库、默认异步非阻塞、全栈跑在可抛弃的云 worker 上，并把自研 trace 调试台列为不用现成方案的关键理由。
items.excerpt: While much of our team focuses on issuing cards, paying bills, and safely moving money, my job for the past several months has been designing and building out Laminar, the in-house agent harness for Ramp’s agentic products.

items.title: LLM Prompt Caching Versus Semantic Caching
items.summary: In this article, we’ll look at how LLM caching works in detail.
items.score_reason: 系统对比 prompt 缓存与语义缓存，附实现与命中率取舍。
items.highlight: 文章区分两套缓存：prompt 缓存要求共享内容放在逐字不变的最前面，靠复用 KV 状态省输入费；semantic 缓存用 embedding 检索旧答案，代价是阈值难定、miss 更贵。
items.excerpt: Caching is a super important aspect of system design, especially for large-scale systems. You can use a cache to store some data that is expensive to calculate so that it can be reused later without paying the same cost.

items.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins (16 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic asked an internal research model to design mini binders, small proteins that attach tightly to a target, against scorpion neurotoxins as part of its work in experimenting with how Claude can accelerate drug discovery. 17 of the 211 designs tested met Anthropic's criteria. Anthropic has not confirmed whether these binders neutralize scorpion venom in a cellular environment, so it is not claiming to have produced an antivenom. However, the study is a promising first step towards using AI to design credible binders against hard-to-target toxins in days, with lab confirmation within weeks. The challenge, as always, will be turning those binders into safe, affordable, and widely accessible drugs.
items.score_reason: 用内部研究模型设计抗蝎毒蛋白结合体，含实验验证数据。
items.highlight: Claude 用约 1 万 GPU 小时、64 小时自主产出 31.8 万个抗蝎毒设计，211 个送两家实验室实测，17 个达标；最强两株与已知中和抗体抢同一表位，全部设计已开源。
items.excerpt: As part of our work experimenting with how Claude can help accelerate drug discovery, we asked an internal research model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.

items.title: Voxtral 3: Voice Agent SDK & Speech Models in 50+ Languages (7 minute read)
items.summary: Voxtral 3 offers advanced speech-to-text and text-to-speech capabilities across 50+ languages. Featuring models like Small Transcribe 3 for multilingual transcription and Mini TTS 3 for natural emotional speech, it includes a voice agent SDK combining real-time listening, reasoning, and speaking, enabling seamless interactions and task execution over phone or web.
items.score_reason: 新版语音模型与 SDK 的多语言语音能力与接口设计。
items.highlight: Voxtral 3 把听、想、说拆成可独立替换的模型，串成一条流式管线，每轮响应不到 1 秒；转录覆盖 50+ 语言，实时版延迟低于 500ms，TTS 支持 35+ 语言与 50+ 方言。
items.excerpt: Speech transcription and voice generation have come a long way, but building end-to-end voice agents that can listen, reason, interact, and handle complex workflows remains difficult.

items.title: Making every harness durable (7 minute read)
items.summary: Vercel's durable-harness allows agent harnesses to run durably in the cloud out-of-the-box. It allows users to run Pi, OpenCode, Codex, and Claude Code durably on Vercel or self-hosted on their own Postgres instance. durable-harness ensures that sessions survive crashes mid-turn and keep running even if the browser disconnects.
